findings.resolution: The browser bounds every response and accepts no stage data until exact authority, stage, capability, permanent-gap, receipt-lineage, timestamp and canonical-digest contracts replay successfully.
The panel permanently displays analysis-only, evidence-incomplete and release-ineligible status and explicitly excludes live-org, deploy, build, test, approval and release claims.
Foundation capture owns separate request and view state; it cannot mutate AssuranceRun, and refresh, malformed, network, timeout, supersession or expiry paths remove older evidence.
The capture timeout is validated host configuration with a five-minute default and a 30-second to 15-minute range, avoiding a demo-scale repository assumption.
Stage state is text as well as color; natural keyboard activation, ready-state announcements, arbitrary identifiers, wrapping and a 390-pixel viewport are verified.
